title: Flashcards: Capitals reversed, Oceania
intro: Flip each card about Oceania. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: Canberra is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Canberra is the capital of Australia.

cards.front: Suva is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Suva is the capital of Fiji.

cards.front: Palikir is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Palikir is the capital of Micronesia (Federated States of).

cards.front: Tarawa is the capital of which country?
cards.explain: Tarawa is the capital of Kiribati.

cards.front: Funafuti is the capital of which country?
